title: Introduction Step Box Hover Border
description: When the pointer is anywhere inside shell chrome (panel, navbar, window), emphasize that container's border. Navbar/footer already work. Fix panel selector mismatch ([data-panel] vs data-slot=panel). Add mode-dock-stack hover border emphasis; active stacks keep border-active-base.
summary: Introduction step boxes no longer keep a permanent emphasized border. Root cause: `GLASS_OVERLAY_BOX_CLASS` used bare Tailwind `border` with `text-foreground`, so the stroke followed `currentColor` (always dark). Removed baked `border` from the shared glass overlay class; CSS now paints `[data-slot="introduction-info-box"]` / `[data-slot="dialog-box"]` with `--border-normal-color` at rest and `--border-emphasized-color` on `:hover`/`:focus-within`. Vitest + Playwright confirm gray→dark only while the pointer is inside.
